description: Create Graph Based On Type. Part of the Graph APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

currentFrom.description: currentFrom date (dd-MM-yyyy). Spring @RequestParam required=false; service still needs a valid period when provided. Optional.

currentTo.description: currentTo date (dd-MM-yyyy). Spring @RequestParam required=false; service still needs a valid period when provided. Optional.

previousFrom.description: previousFrom date (dd-MM-yyyy). Spring @RequestParam required=false; service still needs a valid period when provided. Optional.

previousTo.description: previousTo date (dd-MM-yyyy). Spring @RequestParam required=false; service still needs a valid period when provided. Optional.

type.description: Graph type. Spring default group. Default: group. Optional.

uniqueName.description: Account/group uniqueName for the graph series. Spring default sales. Default: sales. Optional.

interval.description: Interval for graph buckets. Spring default monthly. Default: monthly. Optional.

refresh.description: Bypass cache when true. Spring default false. Default: false. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.
